name: Nyékládháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red triangles, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nyékládháza (a white and yellow shield with a black eagle, a rose and an arm) below the name NYÉKLÁDHÁZA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
